Website Hosting & Support Service The objective of this tender process is to invite proposals for the provision of website hosting, ongoing maintenance and development services for the CORU website. Tenderers shall demonstrate their capability to provide a secure, reliable, and resilient hosting environment that supports the continued availability and performance of the website. Particular consideration will be given to: • The location of the hosting infrastructure and the suitability of the hosting arrangement from a regulatory, operational, and data governance perspective. • The provision of secure and user -friendly content management functionality that enables authorised CORU staff to undertake routine and moderate website content updates without requiring specialist technical support. • The implementation of appropriate security controls, monitoring, and maintenance processes to protect the website from unauthorised access, modification, disruption, or malicious activi

Website Migration Services The successful tenderer shall be responsible for the migration of CORU's existing live website to the proposed hosting environment. The migration service shall include, at a minimum: • Development and execution of a detailed migration plan, including timelines, responsibilities, testing and implementation activities. • Migration of all website content, functionality, configurations and associated assets to the proposed environment. • Measures to minimise disruption to website availability and user experience during the migration process. • Comprehensive testing prior to go -live, including functional, security, performance, accessibility and user acceptance testing. • Provision of rollback and recovery procedures in the event of migration issues. • Preservation of existing search engine rankings and implementation of any necessary redirects and SEO protections during migration. • Post-migration support to address any issues arising following implementation. Usunięcie podatności musi zostać potwierdzone ponowną weryfikacją i udokumentowane. Wykonanie prac objętych danym zleceniem podlega odbiorowi przez Zamawiającego, potwierdzanemu protokołem odbioru.
